**OpenHands/OpenHands #16860** — "feat(skills): replace the all-on skill catalog with an explicit allow-list" — https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/16860 (merged, fixes #16302).

1. **Allow-list change.** Replaces the build-time all-catalog-on behavior with an explicit `enabled_skills` allow-list over the bundled `@openhands/extensions` catalog, defaulting to the 11 catalog entries flagged `defaultEnabled`. `disabled_skills` still governs user- and project-authored skills, and `src/utils/skill-enablement.ts` is the single rule source: the deny-list wins, non-catalog skills stay on unless denied.

2. **Implementation files.** `src/utils/skill-enablement.ts` (link below) supplies `CATALOG_SKILL_NAMES`, `buildSkillEnablementFilter`, and the one-shot `migrateSkillEnablement`. `src/hooks/use-skill-enablement.ts` (link below) shares hydrate/auto-save/toggle logic between the Customize page and the conversation drawer; cloud backends keep deny-list governance.

3. **Test runner.** Per the upstream PR report: `npx vitest run` → 5064 passed, one unrelated pre-existing `dev-with-automation` SIGHUP failure; `npm run lint` and `npm run check-translation-completeness` clean; the 4 new keys are translated for all 15 locales.

4. **New tests.** `__tests__/utils/skill-enablement.test.ts` covers resolution, deny-veto, and every migration branch; `__tests__/hooks/use-migrate-enabled-skills.test.tsx` covers one-shot migration, cloud skip, and no write after a failed settings load. Adapter tests flipped to assert `add-javadoc` no longer reaches the agent context.

5. **Uncertainty.** I personally ran no tests or live verification — Vitest, lint, and translation results are attributed solely to the upstream PR report. Cloud-side behavior (server catalog never reads `enabled_skills`), slash-command loading, and the no-`Core`-tier deviation remain unverified.

**Links:** https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/src/utils/skill-enablement.ts · https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/src/hooks/use-skill-enablement.ts · https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/__tests__/utils/skill-enablement.test.ts

*(183 words — within the 200-word target, under the 280-word cap.)*
